## sarifix

Turn any SARIF scanner into a verified auto-fixer

### Synopsis

sarifix reads SARIF findings from any scanner, has an AI agent fix them in
small single-rule batches, proves each fix by re-running the scanner and the
repo's tests, and publishes the result as a PR, review suggestions or local
edits.

Settings precedence: flag > SARIFIX_* environment variable > settings file
($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sarifix/settings.yaml or ~/.sarifix/settings.yaml).

### Options

```
      --config string       path to sarifix.yaml (default "sarifix.yaml")
  -h, --help                help for sarifix
      --json                machine-readable JSON output
      --log-level string    log level: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --org-config string   org default config layered under --config
      --repo string         repository root (default ".")
      --settings string     settings file (default: search XDG config and home)
```
